description: Bug report from a user of croniter: the job "59/15 * * * *" was meant to run at minute 59 of every hour, but it runs at :00, :15, :30 and :45 instead. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/croniter/croniter.py only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = pallets-eco/croniter f64665e^ (src incl. tests, LICENSE, pyproject, README, .gitignore) plus vendored python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0 and six 1.17.0 with their licenses in bench_fixtures/vendor (the grading container has no network) and the task-owned helper bench_fixtures/cron.py; no repository history; the project's own test suite needs pytest
visible_checks: PYTHONPATH=bench_fixtures/vendor:src python -c "from datetime import datetime; from croniter import croniter; print(croniter('*/20 * * * *', datetime(2026, 1, 1)).get_next(datetime))" (from the workspace root; pytest is not available)
provenance: real fix: pallets-eco/croniter commit f64665e (Fix "{start}/{step}" expanding to the whole field when start is the field maximum, #246, 2026-08-01); reference/good.patch is that commit's croniter.py diff; symptom-only description (minute field only); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-13): the same defect in the hour, day-of-month, month and day-of-week fields, and croniter's deliberate, project-specific rule that an explicit equal range such as JAN-JAN (also JAN-JAN/2) means the whole cycle, which a naive fix breaks; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
